primitives.name: Subject-specific r-squared band-selection statistic (Eq. 1)
primitives.verbatim_quote: The larger the value of r2, the greater the energy diﬀerence between the EEG data of left- and right-handed motor imagery tasks in that frequency band.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: N1, N2 = number of trials in each motor-imagery class (dimensionless integer counts; source text labels BOTH as left-hand trials, an evident typo since P1/P2 are defined as left/right spectra). P1, P2 = EEG power spectra of left-hand / right-hand motor imagery (microvolt^2 per Hz, uV^2/Hz). MEAN(P1), MEAN(P2), STD(P1 union P2) all carry uV^2/Hz, so the mean-difference-over-pooled-STD ratio is dimensionless. The prefactor sqrt(N1*N2/(N1+N2)) is a dimensionless count scaling. r^2 is dimensionless, a squared standardized mean separation (squared point-biserial correlation) in [0,1]. Every term is dimensionally homogeneous; no mixed-unit heuristic anywhere.
primitives.assumptions: Two-class motor imagery (left vs right hand); power spectra computed per candidate frequency band; subject-specific band chosen by maximal r2 before CSP feature extraction and LDA classification (Section 3.2, p. 5). Pooled standard deviation assumes approximately comparable within-class dispersion and stationarity of band power across trials. As printed, N1 and N2 are both described as 'the number of trails for the left-hand motor imagery task'; the P1/P2 definitions make clear N2 is intended to count right-hand trials.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Captures only first-moment (mean power) separation: bands whose classes differ in variance, phase, or higher-order structure but not mean power score r2 near zero. Small trial counts make STD(P1 union P2) noisy and inflate r2 variance. Non-stationary EEG (fatigue drift across a session) violates the pooled-STD assumption. Selecting the band on the same data later used for classification, with no held-out selection described, admits selection bias. The printed N2 definition is self-contradictory and must be corrected to right-hand counts before implementation.

layer2.mapping: Binds as the observation-channel selector for the 22-player football state estimator: given two labeled tactical phases (e.g., high press vs settled mid-block), compute per-frequency-band standardized power separation r2 on tracking-derived signals (team centroid speed, inter-player distance oscillations) and admit only the maximal-r2 band as the input channel to the phase decoder. This is the same invariant: pick the frequency channel where two hidden states are most separable in standardized energy before any spatial filtering.
layer2.telemetry: Optical tracking x,y (m) at 10-25 Hz; band power of centroid velocity (m^2/s^2/Hz); labeled phase epochs from film; dimensionless r2 per band. Underlying psychological fatigue is LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE from tracking alone and needs RPE/HRV proxy channels.

primitives.name: Common Spatial Pattern (CSP) joint-diagonalization spatial filter (Eqs. 2-8)
primitives.verbatim_quote: The EEG signals are passed through this spatial ﬁlter to obtain new signals where one has the largest variance, the other has the smallest variance, and then the two types of signals are classiﬁed by a classiﬁcation algorithm.
primitives.latex: R_1 = \frac{X_1 X_1^{T}}{\mathrm{tr}(X_1 X_1^{T})},\quad R = \bar{R}_1 + \bar{R}_2 = U \lambda U^{T},\quad P = \lambda^{-1/2} U^{T},\quad Z_i = W X_i,\quad f_i = \frac{\mathrm{var}(Z_i)}{\sum \mathrm{var}(Z_i)}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: X1, X2 in R^{N x T}: single-trial EEG matrices, entries in microvolts (uV); N = channel count (dimensionless), T = sample count (dimensionless), with N < T required. tr(X X^T) = sum of diagonal elements, units uV^2; trace normalization makes R1, R2 and the trial-averaged R-bar1, R-bar2 dimensionless covariance matrices. R = R-bar1 + R-bar2 dimensionless, positive definite. lambda = diagonal eigenvalue matrix (dimensionless normalized variances, descending order); U = orthonormal eigenvector matrix (dimensionless). P = lambda^{-1/2} U^T is the whitening transform (dimensionless; source prints it as 1/sqrt(lambda) times U^T). W = spatial filter (dimensionless weights); Z_i = W X_i projected signals in uV; f_i = normalized variance features, dimensionless with sum_i f_i = 1 (simplex-valued). All operations dimensionally homogeneous.
primitives.assumptions: Linear instantaneous mixing model X = A [Y; Y_M] (Eq. 2): task-specific sources Y1 (m1 sources), Y2 (m2 sources) linearly independent, plus common sources Y_M; noise interference explicitly ignored ('when noise interference is ignored', p. 6). N < T so covariance is computable. ERD/ERS (event-related desynchronization/synchronization) makes class identity visible as variance (energy) contrast. Within-trial stationarity for trial-averaged covariances (Eq. 4). Variance normalization of eigensignals guards against movement-induced transients (p. 7).
primitives.breakdown_regime: N >= T makes the covariance rank-deficient; eigenvalues lambda approaching zero make the whitening P = lambda^{-1/2} U^T diverge (singularity regime). Non-stationarity across trials corrupts the averaged covariance. Table 1 (p. 6) states CSP 'Requires multiple leads for analysis and is susceptible to noise interference'. Variance features discard phase and spike-timing information, so classes with equal energy but different timing are invisible. Only two classes are supported by the construction.

layer2.mapping: Derives the linear observation kernel of the 22-player dynamical system: stack tracking into X in R^{N x T} with N = 44 channels (22 players x,y) or 22 team-shape channels; trace-normalized class covariances, joint eigendecomposition and whitening produce projection W whose coordinates maximize variance contrast between two labeled phases. The simplex features f_i become the low-dimensional state input to the Coach-Mind transition kernel, replacing raw positions. The kernel is learned per team/per phase pair, exactly as CSP is learned per subject.
layer2.telemetry: Tracking positions (m) and sampling rate (Hz); per-class covariance eigenvalue spectrum (dimensionless after trace normalization); variance-ratio separation of projected coordinates; held-out phase-classification accuracy calibrates W. Channel count N and epoch length T must satisfy N < T or the kernel is singular.

primitives.name: Linear Discriminant Analysis Fisher criterion (Eqs. 9-14)
primitives.verbatim_quote: the purpose of the LDA algorithm is to make the distance between similar data as small as possible, and the distance between diﬀerent classes of data as large as possible.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: x in R^n: feature vector (here dimensionless CSP normalized-variance features); y in {0,1} class label (dimensionless). mu_j = (1/N_j) sum_{x in X_j} x: class mean vector, dimensionless. Sigma_j = sum_{x in X_j} (x - mu_j)(x - mu_j)^T: within-class scatter as printed in Eq. 11 (UNnormalized by N_j), dimensionless squared-feature units. w in R^n: projection vector, defined only up to scale since the objective is scale-invariant. G1 = w^T Sigma_0 w + w^T Sigma_1 w (within-class scatter, dimensionless^2 feature units); G2 = ||w^T mu_0 - w^T mu_1||_2^2 (squared between-class distance, same units); the ratio G2/G1 is dimensionless. Homogeneous throughout.
primitives.assumptions: Binary classes y in {0,1}; m samples D = {(x_i, y_i)}; linear projection w^T x; each class summarized by mean and scatter only. Fisher optimality implicitly assumes comparable within-class covariance structure; Bayes-optimal linear separation additionally assumes Gaussian classes. Source Eq. 11 uses unnormalized scatter sums, so class sample counts n1, n2 weight the criterion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singular within-class scatter Sigma_0 + Sigma_1 (collinear features, e.g., CSP components with near-zero variance) makes the Rayleigh quotient undefined without regularization. Multimodal or strongly heteroscedastic classes cannot be separated by one linear direction. Because scatter is unnormalized in the source, unequal class sizes bias the boundary toward the larger class. Small-n calibration (the paper uses 9 subjects) makes mu and Sigma estimates themselves noisy.

layer2.mapping: Binds as the phase/deception decision boundary in Coach-Mind: w* is the Fisher direction separating feature clusters of genuine pressure from deceptive show (or press vs rest). The scalar read w*^T x is a one-dimensional constraint input to play-call simulation: calls whose expected execution crosses the boundary into the opponent-favored region are penalized. Same invariant as the source: maximize between-state separation relative to within-state noise before committing a decision.
layer2.telemetry: Labeled phase/deception epochs from film plus tracking; held-out confusion matrix and accuracy; class-conditional scatter eigenvalues to detect the singular regime. No sportsbook odds are used as features or labels anywhere in this mapping.

primitives.name: tDCS anodal subthreshold excitability modulation and NMDA-dependent plasticity
primitives.verbatim_quote: tDCS changes the excitability of the brain by stimulating the membrane potential of neurons, causing depolarization of the anode to lower the threshold of action potential generation, and increasing the excitability of the anodal cortex
primitives.assumptions: Weak current of 1-2 mA applied through paired scalp electrodes (p. 2); subthreshold stimulation of the resting membrane potential, not direct spiking; anodal depolarization lowers action-potential threshold. After-effects require NMDA-receptor expression and GABA release (p. 3). Experimental protocol as printed: 1 mA, 10 min, 5x7 cm saline-soaked sponge electrodes, anode at motor-sensory M1, cathode at forehead (p. 8). Anodal stimulation of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex increases local cerebral blood flow while cathodal decreases it, correlated with MEP amplitude (p. 3).
primitives.breakdown_regime: The modulation is subthreshold by construction: if current density leaves the weak-current regime the mechanism no longer applies. After-effects of tDCS last 'not more than 10 min' (p. 8), so any state estimate made later is uncalibrated. Effects are individual- and state-dependent: the paper's own n=9 experiment shows accuracy gains for all nine subjects under tDCS but with wide spread (mean 88.71 +/- 6.88 percent, Table 3), and the review's Grubaugh '80% psychological / 20% biomechanical' claim (p. 1) is an unverified heuristic, not a measured law, and is excluded from the invariant.
timescales: tau_3: repeated-session adaptation (days-weeks, e.g., 5 d balance protocol, p. 3)

layer2.mapping: Binds as a threshold-bias operator on player decision units: anodal depolarization lowering spike threshold is isomorphic to a neuromodulatory/fatigue state shifting a player's action-initiation threshold theta_i(t) in the 22-player model. Central fatigue raises theta (slower recruitment, higher perceived-effort gate), the hyperpolarization direction; rested arousal lowers it. The mapping is strictly at the level of threshold modulation of a decision unit; it asserts nothing about applying electrical stimulation to football players.
layer2.telemetry: RPE (ordinal), HRV RMSSD (ms), sprint decrement (%), countermovement jump height (cm), simple reaction time (ms) calibrate the latent threshold shift. Cortical excitability itself is LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE from broadcast or tracking data.

primitives.name: tACS endogenous-frequency resonance and spike-timing-dependent plasticity sign rule
primitives.verbatim_quote: When tACS causes presynaptic action potentials to precede postsynaptic action potentials, it produces long-lasting excitation of brain function, and when it causes postsynaptic potentials to precede presynaptic potentials, it causes long-lasting inhibition of brain function
primitives.assumptions: Exogenous oscillatory current entrains endogenous oscillations: 'When the frequency of tACS is the same as the endogenous frequency, resonance occurs' (p. 3). Oscillatory membrane-potential modulation of dendrites/axons makes spikes possible at imposed rhythm. Plasticity sign is set by temporal order: pre-before-post gives long-lasting excitation, post-before-pre gives long-lasting inhibition (STDP). Protocol: 10 Hz chosen as 'mean of mu rhythm', intensity set per subject's stimulation threshold (p. 8). After-effects of 10 Hz, 1 mA tACS reported as 30 min (p. 8).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Frequency mismatch detunes resonance; a fixed 10 Hz drive ignores individual mu-rhythm variability. The source itself states the duration of tACS after-effects 'has not been systematically studied' (p. 8). Mechanism does not guarantee behavior: in the paper's results tACS vs prestimulus p1 = 0.08 and vs pseudostimulation p3 = 0.193 (both nonsignificant, p. 10), and subjects 5 and 8 DECREASED in accuracy after tACS (p. 10). The sign rule is a timing-order invariant, not a promise of net gain.
timescales: tau_0: oscillation cycle (100 ms at 10 Hz)
tau_2: after-effect window (~30 min reported, p. 8)

layer2.mapping: Binds as the timing-order reinforcement rule of coordinated team transitions: a press trigger that reliably PRECEDES a teammate's coverage shift (pre-before-post) potentiates that transition in the team's learned kernel, while reversed order depresses it; repetition under consistent timing is the behavioral STDP analog. Resonance maps to phase-locking of player movement rhythms during synchronized pressing: an imposed shared cadence entrains endogenous movement oscillations only when close to the team's natural frequency.
layer2.telemetry: Event timestamps (s) of press triggers and coverage shifts; phase-locking value of player velocity oscillations (dimensionless); repetition counts and held-out success rate of each coordinated sequence. Individual reversal (subjects 5/8 analog) must be checked per player before applying a population-average timing intervention.

reasoning_traces.think: This source is an eleven-page Hindawi research article, not a monograph: a review of transcranial electrical stimulation (TES) in sports psychology wrapped around one small motor-imagery brain-computer-interface experiment on ten rock climbers, one excluded for noise, leaving nine. The sovereign value is not the headline claim that stimulation improves athletic performance; it is the explicit measurement cascade and its stated failure modes, plus a clean causal-identification constraint. I separate three layers of confidence. First, the mathematics: the r-squared band statistic (Eq. 1), the CSP joint-diagonalization filter (Eqs. 2-8), and the LDA Fisher criterion (Eqs. 9-14) are standard, independently established constructions. Their validity does not depend on this paper's experiment at all, so they can be extracted as source invariants with exact notation and dimensional ledgers. Second, the physiology: anodal tDCS subthreshold depolarization lowering spike threshold, NMDA-dependent after-effects, tACS resonance at the endogenous frequency, and the spike-timing-order sign rule are reported mechanisms, stated as mainstream views (p. 3), and I extract them as reported with their printed parameter regimes (1-2 mA, 10 min, 10 Hz mu-rhythm mean, after-effects <= 10 min for tDCS and ~30 min for 10 Hz tACS). Third, the empirical results: a one-way repeated-measures ANOVA F(3,24) = 10.436, p < 0.05, with tDCS significantly better than prestimulus (p2 = 0.002) and pseudostimulation (p4 = 0.02), while tACS is nonsignificant against both (p1 = 0.08, p3 = 0.193), and subjects 5 and 8 actually worsened under tACS. Nine subjects, four conditions, pairwise comparisons with no multiplicity correction described: this is weak evidence, and the venue (Hindawi, a publisher that later underwent mass retraction scrutiny) demands extra caution. I found no confirmation that this specific article was retracted, so I do not assert retraction; I simply downgrade the empirical layer to low confidence and refuse to let it contaminate the mathematical layer. The cascade itself is the real teaching object. Each stage is a lossy projection with a named discard: r-squared keeps only mean-power separation and discards variance and phase structure; CSP keeps only variance contrast and discards timing; LDA keeps only a single linear direction and discards multimodality. The paper even prints its own defect: the text defines both N1 and N2 as left-hand trial counts, contradicting the P1/P2 left/right definition. A sovereign extraction must preserve that contradiction as printed and flag it, not silently repair it, because the repair is an inference. The experimental design carries a second invariant worth extracting: the 24-hour washout between stimulation and control sessions is justified by the measured after-effect durations (<= 10 min tDCS, ~30 min tACS). That is a causal-identification constraint: to attribute a state change to the intervention, the inter-session interval must exceed the intervention's memory. Translated to any longitudinal athlete-state model, consecutive high-load cognitive or physical sessions must be separated by at least the recovery time constant of the measured after-effect, or the state estimate is confounded. The psychological-fatigue cascade on p. 4 is a retrocausal chain in the source's own words: rapid physical-energy consumption causes rapid decline of functional reserve and central nervous fatigue, which produces inattention, irritability, and lowered will; further deterioration produces slow movement, muscle stiffness, and panic in hands and feet, and in serious cases injury or danger. Note the direction: the hidden central state precedes and causes the observable motor breakdown, so observables are lagging indicators of a latent variable. That is exactly why the layer-2 mappings mark cortical excitability and psychological fatigue LATENT_UNIDENTIFIABLE from tracking alone, requiring proxy telemetry (RPE, HRV, sprint decrement).  Two further source details deserve sovereign treatment. The training configuration in Table 2 (p. 7) fixes initial learning rate 0.002, Adam optimizer, initial momentum 0.5, batch size 30, and a maximum of 40 training sessions, while Figure 2 (p. 5) shows a softmax output layer with cross-entropy loss feeding back propagation. That is a second, nonlinear classifier stacked on the same features, and the paper never reports its accuracy separately from LDA, so the softmax branch is an uncalibrated parallel path and must not be credited with the LDA results. The feature logic itself rests on ERD/ERS: motor imagery desynchronizes or synchronizes sensorimotor rhythms, and because variance represents energy, CSP can extract the components with the greatest energy difference (p. 5). This is why the whole cascade is energy-based and therefore blind to timing: the sign rule of tACS plasticity lives in millisecond order, while the classifier lives in band power, and the two layers of the paper never actually meet. The design is single-blind with stimulation and control order randomized by the subjects themselves (p. 8), which protects against order effects but leaves expectancy uncontrolled on the subject side; pseudostimulation is the only sham anchor, and the tACS-versus-sham contrast fails significance. For the football translation, the N < T rank condition becomes a concrete engineering constraint: a 44-channel full-player tracking matrix requires epochs longer than 44 samples, so at 25 Hz the minimum epoch is about 1.8 seconds, shorter than most tactical phases, which forces either channel reduction to team-shape variables or regularization of the covariance before whitening. Finally, the layer-2 bindings are deliberately structural, not cosmetic: r-squared becomes the observation-channel selector for phase telemetry; CSP becomes the learned linear observation kernel over the 22-player position matrix, with the N < T rank condition carried over as a hard constraint (44 channels demand epochs longer than 44 samples); LDA becomes the deception/phase boundary constraining Coach-Mind play-call evaluation; tDCS becomes a threshold-bias operator on decision units; tACS becomes the timing-order reinforcement rule for coordinated transitions. No football-era origin is fabricated for any of these: CSP, LDA, and the r-squared statistic are general signal-processing and statistical constructions, and the stimulation mechanisms are neuroscience. The Grubaugh 80/20 psychological-vs-biomechanical claim on p. 1 is explicitly excluded as an unverified rhetorical heuristic, not an invariant, because it has no units, no measurement protocol, and no falsifier. Nothing in this artifact uses sportsbook odds, and nothing is publishable: it is internal corpus state only.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: The hidden state of this pipeline was created by a clinical-to-sport translation scar. The source states TES is 'more frequently used in the rehabilitation of patients with neurological impairment or psychiatric disorders' (p. 2), and the BCI architecture explicitly serves paralyzed users and neural-pathway rehabilitation before healthy-athlete enhancement (p. 5). Clinical protocols (20 min daily anodal tDCS over five days for elderly gait, p. 3) were transplanted into a 10 min athlete protocol, and rock climbing was chosen because its danger, difficulty, and independent-combat format load psychological energy heavily (pp. 1-2). That lineage explains why the experiment measures motor-imagery classification accuracy rather than climbing outcomes: the inherited clinical metric survived the translation even though the target population changed.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Under pressure the belief clash mirrors the climber's fear model on p. 4: fear is set by the climber's understanding of obstacle difficulty and trust in protection staff, not by objective danger alone. Translated: the coach's comfort call rests on a narrative belief (the Grubaugh-style 'senior athletes are 80% psychological' heuristic), the defensive coordinator models the quarterback's hesitation as a tendency trap, and the quarterback's internal clock is the endogenous mu rhythm that external pressure tries to entrain. Recursively, the QB models the DC modeling the QB's fatigue state; if the QB believes the DC reads his threshold shift, he alters his pre-snap timing, which changes the very telemetry the DC trusts. Trust in protection, like trust in the pocket, gates whether the latent fear state expresses as panic or composure.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Physiology vetoes high-EV calls through the source's own fatigue cascade: central nervous fatigue precedes inattention, muscle stiffness, and panic, and 'in serious cases, it will lead to sports injury or even danger' (p. 4). A deep-shot call with high schematic EV is vetoed when proxy telemetry (RPE, HRV, sprint decrement) indicates the QB's decision threshold has shifted, because execution variance dominates the EV gain. The tACS result supplies a second veto: subjects 5 and 8 worsened, so a population-average intervention gain cannot be applied to an individual without per-player calibration. The 24-hour washout logic supplies a third: scheduling consecutive high-cognitive-load sessions inside the after-effect window confounds state estimation, vetoing the next aggressive call until the recovery time constant has elapsed.

universal_lens: Every measurement pipeline is a cascade of lossy projections: band selection discards phase, spatial filtering discards timing, linear discrimination discards multimodality. The polymath audit lens asks, at each stage, what invariant is preserved, what is discarded, whether selection and evaluation share data, and whether the rank condition (N < T) holds before any kernel is inverted.
gsi_mapping: Cortical excitability and neurovascular coupling are the clinical core: anodal stimulation increases local cerebral blood flow while cathodal decreases it, correlated with MEP amplitude (p. 3). Oscillatory dendritic and axonal membrane-potential modulation (tACS) connects to axonal shear vulnerability in impact injury, and EEG mu-rhythm ERD/ERS serves as noninvasive telemetry of motor readiness. The fatigue cascade is a bioenergetic central governor on recruitment; the rehabilitation lineage (post-stroke, refs 14 and 18) anchors clinical use.
gse_mapping: Coach-Mind simulation consumes the r-squared/CSP/LDA cascade as a phase and deception decoder over tracking, with the Fisher boundary constraining play-call EV. The fatigue threshold-shift operator gates aggressive calls per player. DFS and portfolio tail risk inherit the individual-reversal lesson (subjects 5 and 8 worsened under tACS): never apply population-average gains to individual projections. Internal artifacts only; no sportsbook odds anywhere; nothing published from this lane.
